snippet.title: Bubsy 4D - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bubsy's back baby and this time it's in 4D! Join our old pal as he pounces from planet to planet taking on the Woolies and a deadly new foe, the BaaBots. Developed by Fabraz, Bubsy 4D is coming soon! 

Wishlist now: https://atari.com/products/bubsy-4d

Join the Atari Discord: https://link.atari.com/atariclubdiscord
